mission: Collector v1 S4: daily collection value history stage (collection_value_points) after the receipt gate, plus 7D/30D/ALL and the labelled day-one preview on the dark /me/collection/value; no collector release

impacts.reason: New independent last stage of the live market-index-snapshot coordinator (python -m app.market_index_daily_pipeline, 20:00 UTC): after the receipt gate and after Market Value and CPI have finished, app.accounts.value_history.run_stage writes collection_value_points for the receipted day in its own session, REPEATABLE READ transaction and job lock (collection_value_history), insert-only with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING plus full-field comparison. Its failure or held lock is reported as collection_value and cannot block or change the Market Value or CPI stages (fixture-comparison tests on SQLite and Postgres). Values are the existing Market Value usable values (receipted archive, positive only, Yuyu sale excluded); 80% comparable-value guard, no minimum card counts (owner Q4). /me/collection/value (404 while COLLECTOR_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED is off; unset on staging) gains window=all, recorded history and the labelled day-one preview (Q5). No change to Market Value, CPI, identity, prices, app/models/**, app/settings.py or requirements; collector import graph: 0 changed runtime inputs.

Step/window math vs an independent Fraction oracle; quantity changes never gain or loss; missing receipt or missing stage day is a break, never 0%; 80% guard with no minimum count; unpriced never 0; Yuyu sale excluded via the real snapshot path; idempotent rerun and fail-closed conflict; Market Value and CPI outputs identical with the stage stubbed, present, failing or locked; producer guard held during the stage; REPEATABLE READ; collector import graph.

Recorded history rules, report field and rollback in collector_accounts.md; dated notes that the coordinator is the live staging start command (checked read-only 2026-10-14) in market_value_daily_pipeline.md and operations.md.

resources.name: market-index-snapshot cron (API image, coordinator gains a last stage)

routes: GET /me/collection/value: window=all accepted; response gains history and preview. Still 404 while COLLECTOR_ACCOUNTS_ENABLED is off (staging: unset). No other route changes.
dependencies: collection_value_points table from migration 3b7d9c1a5e20 (no new migration)
impact.deployment_impact: API and market-index-snapshot redeploy on merge through their normal GitHub triggers. No web, collector watch path or collector-imported module change, so no collector build or rollout; collector_services is empty. No migration; revision stays 3b7d9c1a5e20. The next natural 20:00 UTC run executes the new stage; staging has 0 users and 0 ledger events, so it writes 0 rows.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR (API and market-index-snapshot redeploy through their normal triggers). Then delete the private, non-published rows: DELETE FROM collection_value_points WHERE methodology_version = 1 (0 rows expected on staging).
recovery.trigger: verifier failure; Market Value or CPI stage status or inserted count leaving the usual pattern (succeeded, 60 and 1 on 2026-10-08..13) at the next 20:00 UTC run; collection_value stage failed; any /me route answering other than 404 while the flag is off; any collector deployment record after merge
recovery.backup: Staging Postgres volume backup younger than 24 h confirmed immediately before merge (id and time in the S4 handoff). The change writes only collection_value_points (0 rows on staging) and modifies no existing row.

verification.observation_window: Delivery receipt with API at the merge, revision 3b7d9c1a5e20 and 0 collector deployments (Railway records); then the next natural 20:00 UTC market-index-snapshot run: report contains collection_value (no_op, 0 rows), Market Value and CPI succeeded with their usual inserted counts, exit 0.
